# ENet upstream snapshot

Source: https://github.com/lsalzman/enet

Release: `v1.3.18`

Commit: `2662c0de09e36f2a2030ccc2c528a3e4c9e8138a`

The C sources, public headers, CMake build, release history, README and MIT
license are copied without modification. Examples and documentation generation

external service is required.
